lead.rising: The slow build-up. Expenses, sleep and old endings ask for attention; effort now pays later.
lead.peak: The heaviest part, and the most character-building. Go slowly, keep your routine and be kind to yourself.
lead.setting: The heaviest part is behind you. This last stretch is about money, family and words settling down.
lead.return: Saturn steps back for a few months while it turns. It's a light echo, not a new start.
lead.noneNext: Your next sade sati begins around {{date}}. Until then, Saturn is elsewhere in your chart.
lead.noneDone: No more sade sati is due in the span we calculate.

plain: Sade sati is the seven and a half years when Saturn passes over and around your Moon sign. It isn't a curse. It's a slow stretch that rewards patience and steady effort, and it comes to everyone about every 30 years.

rising.s: Costs creep up and sleep can be lighter. Budget early and keep a wind-down routine.
Old chapters close, and travel or moves are common. Let go of what's finished.
Results lag behind effort for a while. That's the pattern, not a verdict.

peak.s: Tiredness comes in waves. Rest and routine help more than pushing.
You may doubt yourself more than usual. Small kept promises rebuild it.
More falls on your shoulders. Say no to what isn't yours to carry.

setting.s: Spend carefully and build slowly. Avoid big loans until this phase ends.
Say less, mean more. Old family matters may want closure.
Tiredness comes in waves. Rest and routine help more than pushing.

helps: Keep a simple daily routine, even on bad days.
Help someone older or someone who works with their hands, especially on Saturdays.
If it comforts you, the Hanuman Chalisa or a few minutes of quiet prayer on Saturday evenings.
Finish what you start; Saturn rewards follow-through.
helpsNote: Nothing here needs money. No stone, ritual or payment is required to get through sade sati.

fourth.s: A milder 2½-year check-in on home life

eighth.s: A 2½-year stretch to look after health and avoid big risks

next.s: About 30 years after the last one

none.s: None due in the span we calculate
